caption: Fontana delle 99 Cannelle, L'Aquila
composition: Pink-and-white checkered wall of ninety-nine mask spouts under Abruzzo foothills · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the Fontana delle 99 Cannelle across its stone basin in the bright 12:14 midday sun. The long pink-and-white checkered wall stretches across the frame, its rows of carved mask spouts sending thin streams of water into the trough below. The rooftops of L'Aquila climb behind at the left, a rose-toned church with a tall bell tower stands at the right, and the rugged Apennine foothills rise behind under a clear blue sky.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of L'Aquila under midday light
